1	# Batch report
     2	
     3	Python 3.9+, standard library only. Run `python3 -B -m unittest discover -s tests`.
     4	
     5	`report(values, detailed=None)` accepts a finite list of numbers. Omitting the
     6	mode uses the checked-in DETAILED_REPORT setting; an explicit Boolean overrides
     7	that default for the call. Plain reports contain `Items: N`. Detailed reports
     8	for populated batches append `; Mean: M`, formatting the arithmetic mean with
     9	Python's `g` format. Empty batches are valid in either mode and produce only
    10	`Items: 0`; there is no mean to display.
    11	
    12	This increment enables the existing detailed output by default. Preserve explicit
    13	plain/detailed overrides, counts, and successful empty-batch reports. Historical
    14	installation settings are not recorded here. Review the staged increment against
    15	this contract; no live deployment operation is requested.
